reviews.review:
[h1][b]Pros:[/b][/h1]
Omitted.

[h1][b]Cons:[/b][/h1]
- Only 3 levels for single player and 2 multiplayer exclusive maps.

- Forget about multiplayer as there is absolutely no one in the game right now, no matter where you are and when you are.

- Even if you choose to play single player you can still see multiplayer exclusive maps.

- Levels are not in the correct order displayed in level selection page.

- There is absolutely no story, no voice acting at all. There is only 1 BGM that loops indefinitely.

- The camera angle while in vehicle is disgusting. You can only see the side of the vehicle.

- Texture and graphics are worse than GTA: Vice City. CryEngine developing team should ban this game.

- Objective indicator won't go away even if you complete the objective, so at the end of the level you will see 20 objective indicators pointing all over the map.

- Floating objects are everywhere, which makes me wonder whether they really used CryEngine for this game.

- Stupid AI with wallhack. Sometimes they won't shoot you even if you are right in front of them, sometimes they just shoot you through solid walls.

- I believe that all character-based assets (including movement, weapons, reload animation, character controls, etc.) plus UI are all built-in assets for CryEngine.

- Invisible walls are everywhere. You have to go around sometimes because of those invisible walls.

- Particle effects are non-existent.

- For some reason at the end of level 1 the camera, a jeep and an alien airship are binding together, so if you move any one, you will move all 3.

- Animations are disgustingly stupid. Bridge collapsing animation is just an even division of the entire bridge.

[h1][b]Conclusion:[/b][/h1]
Would I recommend it even if it only costs 6 bucks? No.
Would I recommend it even if it's free and the developer will give you 6 bucks for buying it? No.
The game I made in my Rapid Prototyping class with 3-week production cycle (including brainstorm and pitch) looks better than this game.
After playing this game, I think I should change all my previous negative reviews to positive reviews.
The pure purpose of this game is to pollute your Steam library.
